calculate_mrr: calculate Mean Reciprocal Rank at various k cutoffs for information retrieval results
calculate_recall_cap: calculate capped recall at various k cutoffs for information retrieval evaluation
calculate_hole: calculate the Hole metric measuring unannotated documents in top-k retrieval results
calculate_top_k_accuracy: calculate top-k accuracy measuring if any relevant document appears in top-k results
review_custom_metrics: review the custom metrics module containing MRR, Recall Cap, Hole, and Top-K Accuracy functions
